jcr:title: Rotator Cuff Repair
jcr:description: Stryker's comprehensive rotator cuff platform is focused on delivering simple, efficient and innovative technologies for arthroscopic and open rotator cuff repair, so you can focus on the patient.

largeheadline.line1:
Rotator cuff solutions

You expect the best.

And so do we.

Confidence in every partial and full-thickness rotator cuff repair.

Explore our expansive portfolio.

A breakthrough solution for MIRCTs

InSpace balloon implant

text.text:
See the single and double row solutions you've been waiting for

From an all-PEEK self-punching knotless anchor to the industry's first reusable suture passer that does not require a disposable nitinol needle, we offer a complete rotator cuff repair solution designed with the best in mind.

pageshortdescription.shortDescTop: Stryker's comprehensive rotator cuff platform is focused on delivering simple, efficient and innovative technologies for arthroscopic and open rotator cuff procedures, so you canfocus on the patient. Our platform of implants and instrumentation is designed to offer unique solutions to address the complexities of partial, full-thickness and massive irreparable rotator cuff tears (MIRCTs).
